summary: US-9: LLM coaching narrative

ai.s: Adds an LLM coaching layer to the insights portal that writes plain-English narrative and a prioritised action plan per section, never inventing numbers.
ai.pr: Insight sections showed figures without tailored guidance on what exhibitors should do next.
ai.wy: Part of the ExpoIntelligence vision, but deliberately deferred until the dashboards are validated commercially.
ai.oc: Deterministic numbers with LLM-written narrative, cached per exhibitor and data version, are specified; low priority per the 7 Aug team decision.

summary: US-10: Paywall on dashboard (nice-to-have)

ai.s: Lets exhibitors self-purchase the full insights report from a paywalled preview on their dashboard (nice-to-have, v2).
ai.pr: There was no self-service way for exhibitors to buy access to the full insights report.
ai.wy: A potential revenue stream for ExpoIntelligence, deferred behind v1 email-link access.
ai.oc: A locked preview, purchase unlock and auditable entitlement are specified; not to be sized until v1 ships and a payment decision lands.

summary: Native Integration: Infosalon Exhibitor Push + SSO

ai.s: Adds a native InfoSalons integration that pushes ExpoPlatform exhibitor data to the InfoSalons Exhibitor Portal and supports SSO login.
ai.pr: Exhibitor data had to reach the InfoSalons badging and registration portal outside a native integration, with no SSO between the two.
ai.wy: Extends the Integration Hub, following the Aditus exhibitor push pattern (EP-46657).
ai.oc: An ongoing outbound sync on create and update with API-key auth, plus JWT-signed SSO login and account sync endpoints, is specified.

summary: [TechDept][TM-dev/BE] Monolith: implement ICU MessageFormat rendering in the translation layer (plural/select)

ai.s: Adds ICU MessageFormat rendering to the monolith's translation layer so plural and select translations display correctly instead of as raw ICU text.
ai.pr: Translation Manager stores real ICU values since EP-55658, but the monolith only substitutes flat placeholders, so plurals reach end users as raw source.
ai.wy: The agreed follow-up to a risk explicitly accepted in EP-55658.
ai.oc: The monolith translation service is to render ICU plural, select and nested arguments from the Translation Manager's ICU form.

summary: Reuse the unsaved changes guard on the rest of the iframe-embedded admin pages

ai.s: Extends the unsaved-changes guard to the other iframe-embedded admin pages, so parent-frame navigation no longer silently drops edits.
ai.pr: Only the registration settings pages got the EP-56400 guard; exhibitor profile, content settings, networking onboarding and site builder still lost edits on parent-frame clicks.
ai.wy: The same data-loss bug EP-56400 fixed remained reproducible elsewhere in the admin.
ai.oc: The reusable guard is to be wired into the remaining embedded pages, replacing each page's own partial navigation warning.

summary: Internal admin panel search

ai.s: Adds a persistent Admin Panel search that finds pages, settings, entities and hidden text such as tooltips and dropdown options, and jumps straight to them.
ai.pr: The Admin Panel had grown too large to navigate reliably, e.g. 45 ungrouped fields under Registration Settings → Additional Settings.
ai.wy: Admins waste time hunting for settings; distinct from the customer-facing Global Search.
ai.oc: A header search bar is specified over an index of page titles, labels, help text, placeholders and option values, including Analytics & Reports.

summary: Codeception: BaseCest leaks process-wide static state between tests (ExpoConfig::$values), manufacturing false failures in full-suite runs

ai.s: Resets the ExpoConfig static cache between Codeception tests so full-suite runs stop producing false failures that look like product bugs.
ai.pr: BaseCest did not reset ExpoConfig::$values, which caches misses, so a module enabled in the database could read as disabled in later tests.
ai.wy: Reliable tests: leaked static state manufactures failures unrelated to the code under test.
ai.oc: The second process-wide static is to be reset centrally after a verification run; the first leak was fixed in PR #4880.

summary: Flaky unit test: PublicApiLogFiltersReaderTest fails on a warm cache — Cache::getCachedResult skips the mocked call

ai.s: Fixes a flaky unit test for PublicApiLogFiltersReader that fails whenever the CloudWatch filters cache is already warm.
ai.pr: The cached call skipped the mocked CloudWatch method on a cache hit, so the test passed only on a cold cache and failed after other suites warmed it.
ai.wy: Deterministic cache-dependent failures undermine confidence in the test suite.
ai.oc: The test is to isolate or bypass the cache so its expectation holds regardless of cache state.

summary: [BE Test fail] Import suites are red — 53 failures across api-admin and cli, and nothing anywhere turns red

ai.s: Gets the red import test suites passing again: 53 failures across api-admin and cli that nothing flagged.
ai.pr: A full Codeception run showed 25 cli and 30 api-admin failures, mostly import, and the functional suite crashing, with no pipeline turning red.
ai.wy: Surfaced during QA on EP-55347; broken suites hide real regressions in import.
ai.oc: The failing import tests (email dispatch, team member counts and others) are to be fixed and the suites made to signal failures.

summary: Banners sizes streamline

ai.s: Streamlines banner sizes (ticket has no further detail).
ai.pr: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title — no description was provided.
ai.wy: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title.
ai.oc: Not clearly specified beyond the ticket title; presumed to standardise banner dimensions.

summary: Exhibitor event parent/child pair: loaders, error messages and the counterpart index

ai.s: Tidies the exhibitor event parent/child approval pair: loaders, error messages and a counterpart index, after the EP-56280 fix.
ai.pr: Pending and live exhibitor event rows point at each other without foreign keys, and issues such as a save path deleting the row it is saving were left out of EP-56280.
ai.wy: Recorded so the remaining risks are scheduled rather than rediscovered; an exhibitor's save could be lost.
ai.oc: The remaining items around the pair are to be fixed, starting with establishing what happens when the auto-approve branch deletes the row mid-save.

summary: fix Avatar size="xxs" regression in TagSelect breaking build:types

ai.s: Fixes the Avatar size="xxs" regression in TagSelect that breaks the type build and crashes TagSelect items with avatars.
ai.pr: The v8 Avatar rewrite dropped the xxs size but TagSelect still passed it, so build:types failed and styles["xxs"] was undefined at render.
ai.wy: The regression shipped in 0.5.4 and a red build:types gates nothing.
ai.oc: The size is to be mapped to xs or restored per Figma, other dropped sizes fixed, and Avatar made to fall back to its default size.

summary: Make exhibitor manual edits non-destructive

ai.s: Organisers can edit published Exhibitor Manual sections and groups without destroying exhibitors' submitted data; only deletion removes data.
ai.pr: Editing a published manual section could wipe weeks of exhibitor submissions.
ai.wy: Organisers need to fix and adjust the manual after launch without data loss.
ai.oc: A rule is specified: non-delete edits keep submission counts, data and status unchanged, and removed fields are retained but hidden.

summary: move products add/edit route guard onto productInfo and drop the duplicate products request

ai.s: Moves the product add/edit permission check onto the productInfo request the form already makes, dropping a duplicate products request.
ai.pr: The EP-55755 route guard fetched its own copy of permission data on every entry to the product form, adding a request that did not exist before.
ai.wy: Frontend performance, and the limit decision is more correct coming from the backend.
ai.oc: /api/v1/exhibitor/productInfo is to carry the decision, so entering the form costs exactly one request.

summary: Deferred registration emails (email_waiting_condition): payment binding, row lifecycle, confirm-race hardening, .ics on release

ai.s: Hardens deferred registration emails: binds parked emails to their payment, cleans up rows on cancel, fixes a confirm race and sends .ics on release.
ai.pr: Parked emails were keyed only by account and event, so confirming one pending invoice released another's emails and password resets, and cancelled rows were never cleaned.
ai.wy: Edge-case follow-up to EP-56584 raised in PR review, deliberately kept out of the urgent fix.
ai.oc: A nullable payment_id with filtered release, cancel-time clean-up, race hardening and calendar attachments are scoped.

summary: Returning registrant keeps platform access before offline payment is approved (account activated at registration)

ai.s: Decides whether returning registrants should lose platform access until their offline payment is approved, since accounts are activated at registration.
ai.pr: finishRegistration() activates the account unconditionally, so a returning registrant with existing credentials can use the platform before the invoice is reviewed.
ai.wy: Contradicts EP-34905 (no immediate access before approval); the underlying exposure behind EP-56584.
ai.oc: Product decisions on deferring activation and on payment cancel are needed before implementation.

summary: New login flow: after "Incorrect login" the email field on the second screen is locked and the way to correct it is not signposted

ai.s: Signposts how to correct the email after an "Incorrect login" in the new mobile login flow, where the email field is locked on the second screen.
ai.pr: After an unknown email reached the OTP screen and failed, the pre-filled email was locked with no hint that the fix is one screen back.
ai.wy: Raised as tech debt: behaviour matches the criteria, which chose late validation to prevent account enumeration.
ai.oc: The second screen is to indicate how to change the email while keeping the anti-enumeration design.

summary: Exclude surcharge/tax from invoice when offline payment method is selected

ai.s: Invoices no longer include the credit card surcharge when a delegate chooses invoice payment, controlled by an event setting.
ai.pr: Generated invoices still carried the 4.5% card surcharge on ticket and session lines even when the delegate paid by invoice.
ai.wy: Requested by ACI Asia-Pacific & Middle East for RACE 2027 (EP-55785).
ai.oc: With the exclude setting on, invoice-payment orders produce invoices with no surcharge and a net total; card payments are unchanged.

summary: SessionCardVerticalView does not pass address to MetaInfo

ai.s: Makes vertical session cards show the session address, as the other four session card views already do.
ai.pr: SessionCardVerticalView never passed address to MetaInfo, so every vertical card dropped it, including the new Registration sessions step.
ai.wy: Reported by QA on EP-56654; consumers had only hacky workarounds.
ai.oc: The vertical view is to pass address through so MetaInfo renders its own address row.

summary: finish the incomplete Untitled UI v7→v8 upgrade

ai.s: Finishes the incomplete Untitled UI v7 to v8 upgrade so the component library matches the design system and upstream features.
ai.pr: The v8 upgrade stopped part-way, leaving nine files untouched and features half-wired, so design and code disagreed on every input and select.
ai.wy: Found while mapping the design system with Code Connect; most gaps are unsynced upstream files.
ai.oc: Remaining files are to be synced per a per-file audit; hint-text, label, dropdown and 94 new icon subpaths are already done on a branch.
